evidence.detail: Match editing exists at /admin/matches/ via edit_matches/post_matches but is decorated @auth.admin_required — no player-facing score-correction route exists anywhere
No player-facing match correction endpoint or form found in the codebase
Discord OAuth exists; MTGO-Discord linking also exists, so the auth primitives are present but not wired to a score-correction flow

triage.notes: Requires a new player-facing UI, Discord+MTGO link verification logic, and product decisions about constraints (which matches? how long after the fact?). Security surface is non-trivial — a player editing their own recorded results.
